enumDescriptions: Show CL Command Entry after an IBM i connection is established.
On demand only: do not auto-show CL Command Entry. Open it manually with CLPROMPTER: Open CL Command Entry when needed.
clPrompter.cmdEntryShow.description: Controls when the CL Command Entry panel is auto-shown. The On Demand option means manual open only, not never available.

clPrompter.cmdEntryUseSharedSQLJob.description: Use the shared Code for IBM i SQL job for Command Entry CL and SQL. Set this to false to use a different/new SQL job for Command Entry requests. Recommend: `false`

clPrompter.cmdEntryLimitSqlFetch.description: Enable incremental SQL row loading for CL Command Entry statements using `Cmd Entry Sql Fetch Row Limit`. Uncheck this setting for a Fetch Limit of *NOMAX rows (fetch all rows on run).

clPrompter.cmdEntrySqlFetchRowLimit.description: Controls the maximum number of rows per fetch request when `cmdEntryLimitSqlFetch` is checked. Ignored when that setting is unchecked (*NOMAX rows). Higher values can improve result set performance on fast IBM i servers.

clPrompter.cmdEntrySqlFirstPageRowsToFet.description: Rows fetched for the first page only when a SQL statement is run from Command Entry. After first-page display, additional loads use cmdEntrySqlFetchRowLimit.

clPrompter.cmdEntryDebugLogging.description: Enable debug diagnostic logging for CL Command Entry internals (job routing, keep-alive, and SQL execution detail).

enumDescriptions: Expand command-level message sections by default in Command Entry log.
Collapse command-level message sections by default in Command Entry log.
clPrompter.cmdEntryMessageDetails.description: Controls whether Command Entry log entries are expanded or collapsed. Use F10 to toggle anytime.

clPrompter.cmdEntryCommandTextColor.description: Color of CL command text shown in the Command Entry log/history rows. Use CSS color values like #3794ff, blue, or rgb(52, 120, 246).

clPrompter.cmdEntryClearHistoryOnStartup.description: Clear Command Entry panel history and message log when the CLPROMPTER extension starts.

clPrompter.cmdEntryLogSqlStatements.description: Log SQL statements run from Command Entry to the Command Entry History Log.

clPrompter.cmdEntryLogSqlStatementsToCom.description: Log SQL statements run from Command Entry to the Command Entry Log.

clPrompter.cmdEntryLogSnippets.description: Log Snippets that are run to the Command Entry History Log.

clPrompter.cmdEntryLogSnippetsToCommandL.description: Log Snippets that are run to the Command Entry Log.

enumDescriptions: Open the fully resolved Code Snippet text in an editor tab.
Do nothing when a Code Snippet node is clicked.
clPrompter.cmdEntryCodeSnippetTreeClickA.description: Controls what happens when you click a Code Snippet in the tree view (setting key: clPrompter.cmdEntryCodeSnippetTreeClickAction).

clPrompter.kwdColor.description: PARM keyword color in prompter.  Use CSS color values like ##1a237e, blue, or rgb(34,170,34).

clPrompter.kwdValueColor.description: PARM value color in prompter.  Use CSS color values like ##1a237e, blue, or rgb(34,170,34).

clPrompter.kwdColorAutoAdjust.description: PARM keyword color Auto-adjust for best contrast in dark/light/high-contrast themes. If false, uses your color exactly as specified.

clPrompter.saveCmdXMLToFile.description: Write prompted command XML to clp_cmdDefn_<cmdName>.xml. Useful for troubleshooting but not recommended for normal use.

clPrompter.saveCmdXMLFileLocation.description: Directory where clp_cmdDefn_<cmdName>.xml is written when clPrompter.saveCmdXMLToFile is enabled. Enter *TMPDIR, *USERHOME, *WORKSPACE, or an absolute path.

clPrompter.saveCmdPrompterHTMLToFile.description: Save prompter HTML to clp_cmdPrompt_<cmdName>.html for diagnostic purposes. This file can be sent to support for troubleshooting issues with the prompter.

clPrompter.saveCmdPrompterHTMLFileLocati.description: Directory where clp_cmdPrompt_<cmdName>.html is written when clPrompter.saveCmdPrompterHTMLToFile is enabled. Enter *TMPDIR, *USERHOME, *WORKSPACE, or an absolute path.

clPrompter.saveCmdHelpTextToFile.description: Save command parameter helptext to clp_cmdHelpText_<cmdName>_<parmName>.html for diagnostic purposes when reporting issues.

clPrompter.saveCmdHelpTextFileLocation.description: Directory where clp_cmdHelpText_<cmdName>_<parmName>.html is written when clPrompter.saveCmdHelpTextToFile is enabled. Enter *TMPDIR, *USERHOME, *WORKSPACE, or an absolute path.

clPrompter.convertParmValueToUpperCase.description: Convert CL variables, operators (*BCAT, *TCAT, etc.), and built-in functions (%SUBST, %TRIM, etc.) within PARM values to uppercase. When true, text like '&pickles *bcat %trim(&x)' becomes '&PICKLES *BCAT %TRIM(&X)'. When false, preserves original case. Applies when returning from the prompter.

clPrompter.convertCmdAndParmNameCase.description: Case conversion for CL command names and PARM keywords. *UPPER = uppercase (CHGVAR VAR(...)), *LOWER = lowercase (chgvar var(...)), *NONE = no change. Applies when returning from the prompter and when formatting CL source.

clPrompter.formatIndentComments.description: Indent comments. *YES = indent comments, *NO = leave at column 1.

clPrompter.formatLabelPosition.description: Position of the optional command label (1-10 characters followed by colon). Default: 2.

clPrompter.formatCmdPosition.description: Position where the CL command name starts. Must be at least 1 space after the label. Default: 14.

clPrompter.formatKwdPosition.description: Position where the first PARM/keyword starts. Use 0 for one space after command name. Default: 25.

clPrompter.formatContinuePosition.description: Position where continuation lines start. Normally 2 positions after formatKwdPosition. Default: 27.

clPrompter.formatRightMargin.description: Last position where data or continuation symbols (+ or -) may appear. Default: 72.

clPrompter.parmExpansionMax.description: Maximum number of characters a prompted input field can be expanded to by entering & and leaving the field. Default: 5000.

clPrompter.parmExpansionSize.description: Number of characters added to a prompted input field each time the user enters & and leaves the field. Default: 16.

clPrompter.prefetchCommands.default: PGM, DCL, MONMSG, CPYF, CHGVAR, SNDPGMMSG
clPrompter.prefetchCommands.description: Comma- or space-delimited list of CL command names to pre-load when a connection to IBM i is established. For each command, both the Prompter and helptext are prefetched. Leave blank to disable.

clPrompter.udtfSupportLibrary.description: Library on IBM i where clPrompter UDTFs such as CHECK_SYNTAX and CMD_HELP are installed. *TEMPLIB = use Code for IBM i's configured temporary library. Recommended SQLTOOLS or SYSTOOLS. Or enter any user library name. Default: *TEMPLIB.

enumDescriptions: Fast SQL-based helptext via the CMD_HELP UDTF (once installed on IBM i). Requires the CMD_HELP UDTF in the library specified by clPrompter.helpLibrary.
Legacy Helptext generated via the GENCMDDOC CL command. (slow).
clPrompter.parmHelpText.description: Interface to use to retrieve CL command parameter helptext when the ? button is clicked in the prompter.
